items.title: Gibson Brass Band: Joseph Bentley, Albert Miller, Ronald Cayette, Eddie Richardson, George Starling, George…

ctx.x: Was that with George Williams or—? No, that was with a little small band. That was years ago, you know. Playing with a little small combination. Four, five, and six pieces.
That's a band hall, B-Mont. How do you like the brass band?
It's alright. Do you compare it with playing with the dance hall? Yeah, I do. Which one you like the best?
